input.goal: Create a self-contained 3D neon portal web demo in a single index.html (inline CSS + JS, no external libraries, no network). A software 3D renderer (own perspective projection, painter's-algorithm depth sort, flat shading with neon glow) draws onto a full-viewport <canvas id="c">, with an orbiting camera and a glassmorphism HUD.
constraints: Single file index.html; all JS inline; no external scripts, fonts or images.
<canvas id="c"> fills the full viewport (position fixed, 100vw x 100vh, resized on window resize, devicePixelRatio aware). body margin 0, overflow hidden.
Background: dark radial-gradient space, center #1a0b2e fading to #05010d at edges, drawn every frame on the canvas.

Software 3D renderer: implement vec3 math, rotation, perspective projection with camera looking at the portal center; sort all triangles/quads by average depth (painter's algorithm) and fill them with flat lambert shading plus neon stroke edges (shadowBlur glow).

Scene geometry built from boxes, each box = 6 faces: a two-tier platform (lower wide slab + upper narrower slab), twin pillars (left and right), a lintel across the pillar tops, and a crown cap on top of the lintel. That is exactly 6 boxes = 36 box faces. Expose window.app.boxFaces === 36.
Box colors: platform dark #1b1033 with cyan #00f0ff edges; pillars and lintel #2a1450 with magenta #ff2bd6 edges; crown cap #3a1a6a with gold #ffd166 edges.

Six octahedral crystals (8 triangles each = 48 triangles) orbit the portal at different heights, each spinning on its own axis, colored alternating cyan #00f0ff, magenta #ff2bd6, violet #9b5cff. Expose window.app.crystalTris === 48 and window.app.crystals (array length 6).

Portal core between the pillars: a glowing radial-gradient disc (white center to #9b5cff to transparent) plus two concentric rings drawn as projected 3D circles (polylines of >=48 segments) rotating in opposite directions (outer cyan, inner magenta). Expose window.app.rings as an array of 2 objects each with a numeric 'angle' field; their angles change with opposite sign over time.
Cyber grid floor: projected grid lines on the y=0 plane in #ff2bd6 with alpha fading with distance, scrolling slowly.
Exactly 180 twinkling stars (window.app.stars.length === 180), each with a sinusoidally varying brightness, drawn behind the scene.

Exactly 110 rising particles (window.app.particles.length === 110) emitted from the portal region, rising upward in 3D and respawning at the bottom when they exceed a max height, drawn as small glowing additive dots in cyan/magenta.
Orbiting camera: window.app.camera = {angle, radius, height}; when orbit is on, camera.angle increases each frame by dt*0.25*app.speed; initial angle 0.

Glassmorphism HUD panel fixed top-left: background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop-filter blur(12px), 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.18), border-radius 16px, padding 14px 18px, white text, font-family system-ui/monospace.
HUD title text exactly: NEON PORTAL 3D (in an element with id="title"), styled with cyan-magenta glow text-shadow.

HUD stats line with elements id="fps", id="polys", id="parts" showing text 'FPS: <n>', 'POLYS: <n>', 'PARTS: <n>'. POLYS = number of polygons drawn last frame (36 + 48 = 84 minimum). PARTS = 110. Update stats at least 2x per second. Expose window.app.stats = {fps, polys, parts} with numbers.

Three buttons with ids btnPause, btnOrbit, btnReset. btnPause text 'Pause' toggles window.app.paused (boolean, initial false) and changes its text to 'Resume' when paused. btnOrbit initial text 'Orbit ON', toggles window.app.orbit (boolean, initial true) and text becomes 'Orbit OFF' when off. btnReset sets app.camera.angle = 0, app.speed = 1, slider value = 1, paused=false, orbit=true and restores button texts.
Buttons are glassy: background rgba(255,255,255,0.1), border 1px solid rgba(0,240,255,0.5), border-radius 10px, color #fff, hover glow cyan.
Speed slider <input type="range" id="speed" min="0" max="3" step="0.1" value="1"> with label 'Speed' and live value readout; on input sets window.app.speed (number, initial 1).
When paused, animation time does not advance (scene frozen) but rendering loop keeps running with requestAnimationFrame.
window.app must be defined synchronously by the inline script at load.
verify_commands: tandem:ui_test {"steps":[{"exists":"canvas#c"},{"text":"#title","match":"^NEON PORTAL 3D$"},{"wait":800},{"js":"window.app && app.boxFaces===36 && app.crystalTris===48 && app.crystals.length===6 && app.stars.length===180 && app.particles.length===110 && app.rings.length===2"},{"js":"app.stats.parts===110 && app.stats.polys>=84 && app.stats.fps>0"},{"text":"#parts","match":"PARTS: 110"},{"text":"#btnOrbit","match":"Orbit ON"},{"js":"app.camera.angle>0 && app.paused===false && app.orbit===true"},{"expect":"moving"},{"click":"#btnPause"},{"js":"app.paused===true"},{"text":"#btnPause","match":"Resume"},{"click":"#btnPause"},{"click":"#btnOrbit"},{"js":"app.orbit===false"},{"text":"#btnOrbit","match":"Orbit OFF"},{"input":"#speed","value":"2.5"},{"js":"app.speed===2.5"},{"click":"#btnReset"},{"js":"app.speed===1 && app.orbit===true && app.camera.angle<0.2 && document.getElementById('speed').value==='1'"}]}

content.text:
I had Tandem build the demo as a single self-contained `index.html`, and it passed all its checks after two local repairs. I haven't opened the page myself.

In a headless browser the check confirmed:
- **Scene contents:** 36 box faces, 6 crystals with 48 triangles, 2 rings, 180 stars and 110 particles.
- **Running:** the canvas animates and the camera orbits.
- **HUD:** the title reads "NEON PORTAL 3D" and the FPS, POLYS and PARTS readouts update.
- **Controls:** Pause, Orbit ON and Reset work as described, and the speed slider changes the speed.

I spelled out the background, floor grid, colours and glass styling in the brief, but the automated check didn't look at them; the page has to be viewed to confirm those. Open `index.html` in a browser to see it.
